schema: launch_glassies_v4/1 (glassy_revamp_v3/1 plus `follows` and the `drip` idle type)
coordinates: Roblox model space: roblox = (x, z, -y) of Blender; studs at GlassyScale 1; origin = hang point

idle_types.pulse: scale about pivot 1+amp*sin(...); Neon parts also brighten
idle_types.slosh: rotate about axis by -gain*swing angular velocity (deg/s), clamp max_deg, spring freq_hz/damping
idle_types.flicker: random scale jitter amp at rate_hz
idle_types.blink: scale along axis to 0.1 for dur_s every interval_s (+-40%)
idle_types.drip: loop every period_s: scale 0->1 over grow_s at the pivot, then slide fall_studs along the axis while fading, reset

hit_types.kick: rotate deg about axis (sign from hit side), spring back
hit_types.hop: translate studs along axis, spring back
hit_types.squash: scale factor along axis, spring back

follows: A part with `follows` rides the named part: apply the parent's motion first, then its own idle/hit in the parent's frame (fish tail on the fish, eye shine on the eyes, chips on their cookie). Parts with the same motion as the parent repeat it.
body_motion: Glass Top's Body has a cosmetic spin about the hang axis; its stripes, ring, knob and tip follow it.
lod: Low-detail mode: animate only parts with lod_keep=true (plus client-driven kit names).
